label: Town of Fairlee
header:
# Town of Fairlee municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 8; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists three Fairlee Selectboard members: Peter Berger, Miranda Clemson (Chair), and Lance Mills.

Town of Fairlee official Town Meeting Minutes, March 3, 2026 (fairleevt.gov; the file is named 2025 but its contents are the 2026 minutes): the March 3, 2026 town meeting re-elected Clemson to a 3-year term unopposed; Berger chaired the board before the 2026 reorganization and Clemson chairs it in the June 2026 directory.

Town of Fairlee official Town Meeting Minutes, March 3, 2026 (fairleevt.gov; the file is named 2025 but its contents are the 2026 minutes): Article 1 elected Chaz Hinsley Moderator for one year, unopposed.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Georgette Wolf-Ludwig as Town Clerk of Fairlee.

Town of Fairlee official Town Meeting Minutes, March 3, 2026 (fairleevt.gov; the file is named 2025 but its contents are the 2026 minutes): the town's officers tables style the clerk elected for a 3-year term; Wolf-Ludwig has served continuously and no clerk election fell in 2025 or 2026.

Town of Fairlee Selectboard minutes, March 10, 2025 (fairleevt.gov): the March 10, 2025 Selectboard minutes handle the Treasurer inside the annual Appointment Slate ('Jess Chase will be working on the signatories tomorrow. As of now, Lisa Hinsley is still the official Fairlee Town Treasurer'), so the office is filled by appointment and Jessica Chase is recorded as the appointed holder. She is minted as a person distinct from Bradford's appointed Treasurer Jessica Chase: the shared name and office in adjacent towns do not by themselves prove identity.

Town of Fairlee Auditors' minutes, December 19, 2024 (fairleevt.gov): the December 19, 2024 auditors' minutes already style Jessica Chase as Treasurer, and she presented as Treasurer at the March 3, 2026 town meeting.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Lisa Hinsley as Town Treasurer of Fairlee (January 2026), superseded by the town's own records above.

Town of Fairlee official Town Meeting Minutes, March 3, 2026 (fairleevt.gov; the file is named 2025 but its contents are the 2026 minutes): the March 3, 2026 meeting elected Russ Collins Lister for a 3-year term, unopposed; the other two seats are unnamed in the sources read, so one is minted.

Town of Fairlee official Town Meeting Minutes, March 3, 2026 (fairleevt.gov; the file is named 2025 but its contents are the 2026 minutes): the March 3, 2026 meeting elected Jane Chambers Auditor for a 1-year term; the 2-year auditor seat drew no nominations and was passed over, leaving it vacant, and the third seat is unnamed in the sources read.
Town of Fairlee Auditors' minutes, December 19, 2024 (fairleevt.gov): the auditors' minutes are signed by Jane Wilson Chambers, her fuller form of name.

Town of Fairlee official Town Meeting Minutes, March 3, 2026 (fairleevt.gov; the file is named 2025 but its contents are the 2026 minutes): the town meeting elects one Budget Committee member yearly to a 3-year term (three seats); Keri Gelenian was elected March 3, 2026. The other two seats are unnamed in the sources read.

Town of Fairlee official Town Meeting Minutes, March 3, 2026 (fairleevt.gov; the file is named 2025 but its contents are the 2026 minutes): the town meeting elects one Cemetery Commissioner yearly to a 5-year term (five seats); Chaz Hinsley was elected March 3, 2026. The other four seats are unnamed in the sources read.

Town of Fairlee official Town Meeting Minutes, March 3, 2026 (fairleevt.gov; the file is named 2025 but its contents are the 2026 minutes): the town meeting elects Library Trustees to 5-year terms (five seats); Charlotte Williams was elected March 3, 2026. The other four seats are unnamed in the sources read.

Town of Fairlee Selectboard minutes, March 10, 2025 (fairleevt.gov): the March 10, 2025 Appointment Slate names Dan Ludwig as appointed First Constable for the ensuing year, so the office is appointive in Fairlee; no 2026 slate outcome was read, so the seat is left unfilled. Structure only.

Town of Fairlee Selectboard minutes, March 10, 2025 (fairleevt.gov): the office of Collector of Delinquent Taxes sits on the Selectboard's annual Appointment Slate; the holder is unnamed in the sources read, so the seat is left unfilled. Structure only.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five Fairlee justices of the peace: Peter Berger, Eric Brooks, Rita Temple Brooks, Calista Diane, and Timothy Danen.

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five Fairlee justices of the peace elected November 5, 2024: Peter Berger, Eric Brooks, Rita Temple Brooks, Calista Diane, and Timothy Danen. The listing publishes no vote totals or party labels and none are recorded.
